description: Implements docs/update-policy.md. Rules are ordered: a later rule overrides an earlier one, so the most specific rules come last.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fast path: a fix for a published advisory skips the cooldown and auto-merges once the PR check passes. Majors still need a human.

packageRules.description: Default tier for language packages (npm, crates, PyPI, Go modules), images and charts: established. 7 day cooldown (top-level minimumReleaseAge); minor, patch and pin updates auto-merge once the PR check passes.
Majors are never auto-merged outside the own tier.
A digest change under an unchanged tag looks exactly like a re-pointed tag, so it is reviewed by hand.
Core tier Actions (actions/*, github/*): 3 day cooldown.

Sensitive: every Action this repository's own workflows run receives credentials (a write GITHUB_TOKEN, OIDC id-token, secrets) or runs on the self-hosted runner, so its bumps are always a PR to read. Actions in templates/ do not run here and keep the rules above.
Own tier: your own packages, images and Actions are your CI output, so there is no upstream compromise to wait out.
